3.name: Archfey Spells & Steps of the Fey (Archfey Patron)
3.description: Always have Archfey spells prepared and cast Misty Step CHA modifier times per Long Rest with fey teleportation effects.

6.name: Misty Escape (Archfey Patron)
6.description: Cast Misty Step as a Reaction when taking damage, adding Disappearing Step (invisible) or Dreadful Step (2d10 Psychic damage).

10.name: Beguiling Defenses (Archfey Patron)
10.description: Gain Immunity to Charmed, and use your Reaction to grant Resistance to incoming damage while bouncing 2d10 Psychic damage back at the attacker.

14.name: Bewitching Magic (Archfey Patron)
14.description: Immediately cast Misty Step without a slot after casting an Enchantment or Illusion spell with a spell slot.

dreadful_step.name: Dreadful Step
dreadful_step.hint: When teleporting with Steps of the Fey / Misty Escape, creatures within 5 ft take 2d10 Psychic damage (WIS save).

3.name: Celestial Spells & Healing Light (Celestial Patron)
3.description: Gain Sacred Flame and Light, keep Celestial spells prepared, and spend d6s from a Healing Light pool as a Bonus Action.

6.name: Radiant Soul (Celestial Patron)
6.description: Gain Resistance to Radiant damage, and once per turn add your CHA modifier to Fire or Radiant spell damage.

10.name: Celestial Resilience (Celestial Patron)
10.description: After a Short or Long Rest (or Magical Cunning), grant yourself Temporary HP equal to Warlock level + CHA mod and up to 5 allies half Warlock level + CHA mod.

14.name: Searing Vengeance (Celestial Patron)
14.description: When making a Death Save, regain half your HP max, stand up, and deal 2d8 + CHA mod Radiant damage plus Blindness to nearby foes (once per Long Rest).

healing_light.name: Healing Light
healing_light.hint: Bonus Action spends d6s from a pool of (1 + Warlock level) dice to heal a creature within 60 ft.

3.name: Dark One's Blessing & Fiend Spells (Fiend Patron)
3.description: Always have Fiend spells prepared and gain Temporary HP equal to CHA modifier + Warlock level when a nearby enemy falls to 0 HP.

6.name: Dark One's Own Luck (Fiend Patron)
6.description: Add 1d10 to an ability check or saving throw after seeing the roll (CHA modifier uses per Long Rest).

10.name: Fiendish Resilience (Fiend Patron)
10.description: Choose one damage type other than Force after each Short or Long Rest and gain Resistance to it.

14.name: Hurl Through Hell (Fiend Patron)
14.description: Once per Long Rest (or by expending a Pact slot), banish a hit target through the lower planes for 8d10 Psychic damage and Incapacitation.

dark_ones_own_luck.name: Dark One's Own Luck
dark_ones_own_luck.hint: Add 1d10 to an ability check or saving throw after seeing the roll (CHA mod uses per Long Rest).

hurl_through_hell.name: Hurl Through Hell
hurl_through_hell.hint: On hit (1/Long Rest or Pact Slot): banish target through the lower planes for 8d10 Psychic damage (CHA save).

3.name: Awakened Mind & Psychic Spells (Great Old One Patron)
3.description: Always have Great Old One spells prepared, communicate telepathically, omit Verbal/Somatic components on Illusion/Enchantment spells, and swap spell damage to Psychic.

6.name: Clairvoyant Combatant (Great Old One Patron)
6.description: A creature linked via Awakened Mind suffers Disadvantage on attacks against you while you gain Advantage on attacks against it (once per Short/Long Rest).

10.name: Eldritch Hex & Thought Shield (Great Old One Patron)
10.description: Gain Resistance to Psychic damage, prevent mind-reading, and impose Disadvantage on one ability's saving throws via Hex.

14.name: Create Thrall (Great Old One Patron)
14.description: Always have Summon Aberration prepared and summon an Aberration without Concentration (with bonus Temporary HP) for 1 minute.
